art_direction: 奶油黄底，左眼略高更眯，同望右上方，像已准备就绪。
composition_variation: Use similar-width eyes, left more closed and a little higher. Both large pupils look up-right under broad firm but unstrained lids. Matching iris appears as thin side bands and fuller lower arcs with slim glints. Express focused readiness and quiet optimism, without action symbols or props. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
